text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it brings important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI learns from old data that contains unfair patterns, it may treat people unfairly, for example in job hiring or loan decisions. Fairness means we must check these systems carefully to reduce such errors. Privacy is also critical, since AI often uses personal information; we need clear rules to protect people's data. Transparency is another key point: users should know when they are interacting with AI and understand how decisions are made. Ultimately, responsible AI development requires teamwork between engineers, policymakers, and the public to build technology that benefits everyone safely.
